title: 重结晶与熔点分析
source_doc: course/Fume Hood & Cabinet Protocols/06_Recrystallization and Melting Point Analysis.md
author_source: project/Fume Hood & Cabinet Protocols/06_Recrystallization and Melting Point Analysis/src.py

points.K7: 示例：粗苯甲酸与蒸馏水
points.K13: 溶完取出玻璃棒和搅拌子

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，手里托着一瓶闪亮的白色晶体，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab bench holding a small jar of sparkling white crystals and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲重结晶和熔点测定。

shots.scene: 溶解、冷却、过滤、测熔点四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a beaker on a hot plate, a beaker with a snowflake, a funnel on a flask and a thin capillary tube in a heating block. No people.
shots.narration: 热溶、冷析、抽滤、测熔点。

shots.scene: 阿杰举着一小瓶发黄的粉末，皱着眉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds up a small vial of slightly yellowish powder and frowns.
shots.narration: 阿杰做出的产品，颜色发黄不纯。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着显微镜看粉末，里面夹着杂色小点
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at the powder under a magnifier; tiny colored specks are mixed in with the white grains.
shots.narration: 里面混着杂质，该怎么提纯？

shots.scene: 小研指着白板上的空白流程图
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a blank flowchart on a whiteboard while the young male student listens.
shots.narration: 小研说：重结晶，一步步来。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 热溶冷析，产品就能变纯。

shots.scene: 漏斗、分液漏斗图标淡出，出现一个晶体图标
shots.prompt_en: A filter funnel icon and a separatory funnel icon fade back, and a shining crystal icon appears in front. No people.
shots.narration: 前面学了过滤、萃取等分离方法。

shots.scene: 反应瓶中出现白色固体
shots.prompt_en: A reaction flask in which a white solid forms at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 反应常常得到固体，还需要纯化。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶里的水层析出白色沉淀
shots.prompt_en: An Erlenmeyer flask with a blank label in which a white precipitate forms in the water layer. No people.
shots.narration: 之前萃取后，水层里析出了固体。

shots.scene: 小研把浑浊液倒入布氏漏斗抽滤
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a lab coat, goggles and gloves, pours the cloudy mixture into a filter funnel on a suction flask.
shots.narration: 当时用抽滤把它收集了下来。

shots.scene: 沉淀颗粒的晶格里夹着几个彩色杂质小点
shots.prompt_en: A close-up diagram of a crystal lattice with a few colored impurity dots trapped inside. No people.
shots.narration: 可沉淀析出时，会把杂质夹在里面。

shots.scene: 产物和杂质两个图标，旁边各有一个溶解度条
shots.prompt_en: Two icons, a white product crystal and a colored impurity dot, each with a different height bar beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 产物和杂质，溶解度不一样。

shots.scene: 针状晶体在烧杯中生长
shots.prompt_en: Clean needle-shaped crystals grow inside a beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 利用这个差别，就能把产物提纯。

shots.scene: 粗品粉末倒入热溶剂中溶解，温度计向上箭头
shots.prompt_en: Off-white powder dissolves in a beaker of hot solvent, with a thermometer icon and an upward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 先把粗品溶进热的溶剂里。

shots.scene: 溶液冷却，白色晶体析出，彩色小点留在液体中
shots.prompt_en: The solution cools with a downward arrow; white crystals form while colored impurity dots stay floating in the liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 冷却后，产物重新结晶析出。

shots.scene: 彩色杂质小点在液体中游动
shots.prompt_en: Colored impurity dots drift freely in the clear liquid above the crystals. No people.
shots.narration: 杂质更易溶，留在溶液里。

shots.scene: 溶解度随温度升高的曲线
shots.prompt_en: A simple blank graph with a curve rising from left to right, a thermometer icon on the horizontal axis. No people.
shots.narration: 多数固体，温度越高溶得越多。

shots.scene: 小研举起大小两个烧杯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat and gloves holds up a large beaker and a small beaker.
shots.narration: 大小两个烧杯，250和150毫升。

shots.scene: 加热搅拌器、本生灯、搅拌子、玻璃棒特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hot plate stirrer, an unlit Bunsen burner, a white stir bar and a glass stirring rod on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 加热搅拌器，没有就用本生灯。

shots.scene: 抽滤装置、粉末漏斗、表面皿、滴管特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a suction filtration setup, a powder funnel, a watch glass and disposable droppers. No people.
shots.narration: 抽滤装置、粉末漏斗、表面皿、滴管。

shots.section_title: 示例：粗苯甲酸与蒸馏水
shots.scene: 一瓶空白标签的白色粉末和一瓶蒸馏水
shots.prompt_en: A jar of off-white powder with a blank label next to a wash bottle of distilled water with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 这次提纯粗苯甲酸，溶剂用蒸馏水。
overlay: 示例：粗苯甲酸与蒸馏水

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一个问号卡片，旁边是几瓶不同溶剂
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a card with a question mark next to several solvent bottles with blank labels.
shots.narration: 选对溶剂，是重结晶最关键的一步。

shots.scene: 杂质图标在冷热两个烧杯中都溶解
shots.prompt_en: Two beakers, one hot and one cold; colored impurity dots stay dissolved in both. No people.
shots.narration: 杂质最好冷热都溶，或者冷热都不溶。

shots.scene: 产物图标只在热烧杯里溶解，冷烧杯里析出
shots.prompt_en: Two beakers: the white product dissolves in the hot one and forms crystals in the cold one. No people.
shots.narration: 产物要热时溶、冷时析出。

shots.scene: 小研对着电脑屏幕查一张空白表格
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks up a blank data table on a computer screen.
shots.narration: 查溶解度数据，比较不同溶剂。

shots.scene: 沸水烧杯的溶解度条高，室温烧杯的低（56.31与3.44克每升）
shots.prompt_en: Two beakers with bars: a tall bar for a steaming hot water beaker and a short bar for a room temperature beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 苯甲酸在沸水里溶得多，冷水里很少。

shots.scene: 自来水龙头图标被打叉，蒸馏水瓶打勾
shots.prompt_en: A tap water faucet icon crossed out with a red X next to a distilled water bottle with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 用蒸馏水，免得自来水带进杂质。

shots.scene: 小研把蒸馏水倒进大烧杯，放到加热板上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours distilled water into the large beaker and sets it on the hot plate.
shots.narration: 大烧杯里预热150毫升蒸馏水。

shots.scene: 小研在天平上称粉末，经粉末漏斗倒入小烧杯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student weighs the powder on a balance and pours it through a powder funnel into a clean dry small beaker.
shots.narration: 称3克粗品，放进干净干燥的小烧杯。

shots.scene: 小研戴丁腈手套直接拿起热水烧杯，用滴管吸热水
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing thin nitrile gloves, picks up the hot water beaker by hand and draws hot water with a disposable dropper.
shots.narration: 用滴管吸热水，加到粗品里。

shots.scene: 小烧杯里粉末逐渐变少
shots.prompt_en: Inside the small beaker the powder slowly shrinks as a little hot water is added. No people.
shots.narration: 每次少加一点，看着它慢慢溶。

shots.scene: 两个烧杯并排在加热板上，小烧杯里搅拌子转动
shots.prompt_en: Two beakers side by side on the hot plate; a stir bar spins in the small beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 放入搅拌子，边加热边搅拌边加水。

shots.scene: 计算器图标旁一个估算的刻度线
shots.prompt_en: A calculator icon next to a beaker with a dashed estimated fill line. No people.
shots.narration: 按溶解度估算，3克约需100毫升。

shots.scene: 刚好溶完的清澈溶液打勾，溶剂过多的大半杯打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a small beaker of just dissolved clear solution with a green check, and a beaker with far too much solvent crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 固体要溶完，但溶剂越少越好。

shots.scene: 溶剂太多的烧杯冷却后只析出几粒晶体
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a beaker with too much solvent that forms only a few crystals after cooling, with a sad face. No people.
shots.narration: 加多了，冷却后析出就少了。

shots.section_title: 溶完取出玻璃棒和搅拌子
shots.scene: 小研用镊子取出搅拌子，拿出玻璃棒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student removes the stir bar with tweezers and takes out the glass rod.
shots.narration: 溶完后，取出玻璃棒和搅拌子。
overlay: 溶完取出玻璃棒和搅拌子

shots.scene: 清澈溶液中漂着几粒不溶的颗粒
shots.prompt_en: A hot clear solution with a few undissolved dark particles floating in it. No people.
shots.narration: 冷却前，看看还有没有不溶的杂质。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套，把热溶液倒入过滤漏斗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing nitrile gloves, pours the hot solution into a filter funnel.
shots.narration: 有的话，要立刻趁热过滤掉。

shots.scene: 溶液冷却后晶体留在滤纸上的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of crystals stuck on filter paper after the solution cooled in the funnel, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 等冷了再滤，产物也会被滤掉。

shots.scene: 小研给烧杯盖上表面皿，放在台面上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student covers the beaker of clear solution with a watch glass and leaves it on the bench.
shots.narration: 溶液澄清后，盖上表面皿。

shots.scene: 烧杯中晶体一根根慢慢长出
shots.prompt_en: Needle crystals slowly grow one by one inside the covered beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 室温下慢慢冷却，晶体越长越多。

shots.scene: 摇晃烧杯的手的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand shaking a beaker, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 耐心等，不要搬动或摇晃。

shots.scene: 烧杯放进冰水浴
shots.prompt_en: The beaker is set into a bowl of ice water. No people.
shots.narration: 最后放进冰浴或冰箱五分钟左右。

shots.scene: 晶体沉在杯底，彩色杂质小点留在上方液体
shots.prompt_en: White crystals settle at the bottom while colored impurity dots stay in the liquid above. No people.
shots.narration: 产物析出完全，杂质留在液体里。

shots.scene: 小研用玻璃棒搅动后，把混合物倒入布氏漏斗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stirs the mixture with a glass rod and pours it into a filter funnel on a suction flask.
shots.narration: 搅一搅，倒进布氏漏斗抽滤。

shots.scene: 晶体留在滤纸上，液体流进抽滤瓶
shots.prompt_en: Crystals collect on the filter paper while liquid drains into the suction flask. No people.
shots.narration: 晶体留在滤纸上，常压过滤也行。

shots.scene: 小研用洗瓶向晶体上淋少量冷水
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student squirts a little cold distilled water over the crystals in the funnel.
shots.narration: 用少量纯溶剂淋洗晶体。

shots.scene: 晶体表面的彩色液膜被冲走
shots.prompt_en: A thin colored liquid film on the crystals is washed away, leaving clean white crystals. No people.
shots.narration: 把沾着杂质的母液洗下去。

shots.scene: 抽滤继续，滤饼变干
shots.prompt_en: The suction keeps running and the white filter cake becomes dry and crumbly. No people.
shots.narration: 再抽几分钟，让晶体更干。

shots.scene: 表面皿上的晶体在台面晾干，旁边是烘箱图标
shots.prompt_en: Crystals spread on a watch glass air drying on the bench, with a drying oven icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 然后室温晾干，或放烘箱烘干。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着放大镜看晶体
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks at a watch glass of crystals through a magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 提纯得怎么样？测熔点就知道。

shots.scene: 粗品、精制品、文献值三个图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Three icons side by side: an off-white powder, a white crystal and a blank book. No people.
shots.narration: 和粗品、和文献值比一比。

shots.scene: 小研把熔点管开口端插进晶体里
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses the open end of a thin capillary tube into the crystals.
shots.narration: 取极少量样品，装进熔点管。

shots.scene: 熔点管在台面上轻敲，样品落到管底
shots.prompt_en: A capillary tube is tapped gently so the sample drops to the closed bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 轻轻敲实，让样品落到管底。

shots.scene: 小研把熔点管插进熔点仪，开机
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing safety goggles, slides the capillary into a melting point apparatus and switches it on.
shots.narration: 放进熔点仪，开机慢慢升温。

shots.scene: 小研从目镜里观察
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks through the eyepiece of the melting point apparatus.
shots.narration: 接近预期温度时，从目镜观察。

shots.scene: 管中样品出现第一滴液体，旁边温度计图标
shots.prompt_en: Inside the capillary the solid shows the first drop of liquid, with a thermometer icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 一开始熔化，记下温度。

shots.scene: 样品全部变成透明液体，温度计图标
shots.prompt_en: The sample in the capillary becomes completely clear liquid, with a thermometer icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 全部熔化，再记一次，这就是熔程。

shots.scene: 两条温度区间：宽的标黄，窄的标绿
shots.prompt_en: Two horizontal bars on a blank thermometer scale: a wide yellow bar and a narrow green bar. No people.
shots.narration: 不纯的样品，熔程宽，差好几度。

shots.scene: 窄区间紧挨着文献值虚线
shots.prompt_en: The narrow green bar sits right at a dashed reference line. No people.
shots.narration: 纯的样品熔得快，接近文献值。

shots.scene: 小研按下熔点仪开关
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses the power switch of the melting point apparatus off.
shots.narration: 用完，记得关闭熔点仪。

shots.scene: 天平称表面皿上的晶体
shots.prompt_en: Crystals on a watch glass are weighed on a balance with a blank display. No people.
shots.narration: 称一称得到的晶体。

shots.scene: 公式图示：回收质量除以原质量乘一百
shots.prompt_en: A simple fraction diagram with a small crystal pile on top, a larger powder pile below, and a percent sign. No people.
shots.narration: 回收率等于回收质量除以原质量。

shots.scene: 百分比条没有满格
shots.prompt_en: A progress bar icon that stops short of full, with a small pile of lost crystals beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 去掉了杂质，也会损失一些，总不到百分百。

shots.scene: 冰浴中的烧杯迟迟不出晶体
shots.prompt_en: A beaker sits in an ice bath with a clear solution and no crystals, a clock icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 有时冷到冰浴，晶体还是不出来。

shots.scene: 小研用玻璃棒轻轻刮擦烧杯内壁
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gently scratches the inside wall of the beaker with a glass rod.
shots.narration: 杯壁太光滑，可用玻璃棒轻刮内壁。

shots.scene: 刮痕处冒出小晶核并长大
shots.prompt_en: Tiny crystal seeds appear at the scratch marks and begin to grow. No people.
shots.narration: 细小的颗粒，就是晶体生长的起点。

shots.scene: 小研用刮刀加入几粒纯晶体
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adds a few tiny pure crystals to the solution with a spatula.
shots.narration: 也可以加几粒纯产品当晶种。

shots.scene: 分子小球围着晶种排列成晶格
shots.prompt_en: Small molecule balls line up around a seed crystal and build a lattice. No people.
shots.narration: 其他分子顺着晶种排列长大。

shots.scene: 第一种溶剂溶解粉末，加入第二种溶剂后析出晶体
shots.prompt_en: A beaker where powder dissolves in a first solvent, then a second solvent is added from a dropper and crystals slowly form. No people.
shots.narration: 更复杂的，可用两种溶剂配合。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up next to the beaker of crystals.
shots.narration: 一种溶解，一种促使结晶。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现溶剂瓶和溶解度曲线图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a solvent bottle and a rising solubility curve.
shots.narration: 选对溶剂，热溶冷析。

shots.scene: 少量溶剂、热过滤、缓慢冷却三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a small amount of solvent, a hot filter funnel and a covered beaker cooling. No people.
shots.narration: 溶剂要少，趁热过滤，静置冷却。

shots.scene: 抽滤、洗涤、干燥图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a filter funnel on a flask, a wash bottle and a watch glass of crystals. No people.
shots.narration: 抽滤洗涤，再干燥。

shots.scene: 熔程窄条和回收率条图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a narrow melting range bar and a percent bar. No people.
shots.narration: 测熔程判纯度，算回收率。

shots.scene: 刮擦器壁、晶种、两种溶剂图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a glass rod scratching a beaker wall, a seed crystal and two solvent bottles. No people.
shots.narration: 不结晶就刮壁、加晶种。

shots.scene: 欣欣捧着一瓶洁白晶体挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a jar of pure white crystals and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 晶体纯纯的，实验稳稳的，再见！
